name: io.github.nomarj/sigil
title: Sigil
description: Security scanning tools for AI agent code, packages, and repositories, backed by the Sigil CLI.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_BINARY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Sigil CLI binary used by the scan, clone, quarantine and report tools. Defaults to `sigil` on PATH. Without the CLI the server still starts and the database-backed tools keep working.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Sigil public scan database used by sigil_check_package and sigil_search_database.
